subject: v-sy
title: V.SY.------POL.DY.
description: Diagram in SD(SY)-40 (Spectacle-Diversion Syndrome, Level One) accompanying Braxton's analysis of media as the gatekeeper of alternative considerations: 'as long as western culture can give the illusion that western information principles are valid when applied to any offering from the world group aesthetic, this practice will continue.' V-SY (the vibrational system) is crossed with POL-DY (political dynamics): the question is what vibrational-system produces when crossed with political-dynamics, where political-dynamics is the gatekeeping function executed by media. MOT-DY (motion dynamics) and POL-DY appear together in the upper-left, with RT-ALGN (reality alignment) on the upper-right. INFO-INTR (information interior) feeds into the subject from the left. DY-F (dynamics fundamental) hangs on the right margin. POL-P (political particulars) sits below political-dynamics. RT-OP (reality operation) anchors the lower-center. PART (participation) hangs on the lower-right margin. Structural argument: the vibrational-system crossed with political-dynamics is fed by motion-dynamics, information-interior, and the political-particulars/reality-operation lower chain. The crossing produces reality-alignment as the upper output and dynamics-fundamental and participation as marginal outputs. The diagram exposes Braxton's structural diagnostic: the vibrational-system cannot produce real reality-alignment without going through political-dynamics first — which is precisely why media (the operational form of political-dynamics in this section) controls what counts as 'aligned reality.'
